<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 4 types of dinosaurs (slayer monster), all of which are found on Anachronia:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Feral dinosaurs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1" alt="feraldinosaur" title="feraldinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 90 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Venomous dinosaurs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1" alt="venomousdinosaur" title="venomousdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 105 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Brutish dinosaurs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1" alt="brutishdinosaur" title="brutishdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 99 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ripper dinosaurs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1" alt="ripperdinosaur" title="ripperdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 114 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dinosaurs are only assigned by Laniakea </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1" alt="laniakea" title="laniakea" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>CANNOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> be placed in the player owned dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ All of them attack with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes the best style to use against them </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, followed by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should not be used for any dinosaur tasks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>All dinosaurs have the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>same drop rates for uniques and Totem pieces</nowiki></strong><nowiki>. It is thus recommended to kill </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Venomous Dinosaurs</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1" alt="venomousdinosaur" title="venomousdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level is high enough as they have the highest KPH.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dinosaur tooth - 1/800</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Needed for T3 Slayer Lodge for Slayer Helmet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stand</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Blowpipe pieces </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794591830056961.png?v=1" alt="upgradedboneblowpipe" title="upgradedboneblowpipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 1/6,000 on-task, 1/20,000 off-task</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Totem of auras middle </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1" alt="vitalitytotem" title="vitalitytotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 1/300</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Totem of Summoning middle </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811539499.png?v=1" alt="summtotem" title="summtotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 1/300</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Totem of intimidation base </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594794631198.png?v=1" alt="intimidationtotem" title="intimidationtotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 1/300</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dinosaur rib bone - 1/1,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Needed for T3 Player Lodge for Skillcape stand</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>During the Roar of Osseous, blowpipe and totem pieces have a 10% increase in drop rate.</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Abyssal_armour_spikes_(alloy) <strong><nowiki>Abyssal Armour Spikes (alloy)</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/947871842541129768.png?v=1" alt="abyssalarmourspikesalloy" title="abyssalarmourspikesalloy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Increases </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits and healing via the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="VampScrim" title="VampScrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Other tiers of armour spikes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004090524669587517.png?v=1" alt="armourspike" title="armourspike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756235792053174332.png?v=1" alt="armourspikealloy" title="armourspikealloy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> work as well.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Essence_of_Finality_amulet <strong><nowiki>Essence of Finality</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> with a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_halberd <strong><nowiki>Dragon Halberd</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841409589261238282.png?v=1" alt="dragonhalberd" title="dragonhalberd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Good AoE spec to use if killing them actively with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Necklace_of_Salamancy <strong><nowiki>Necklace of Salamancy</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/970657245312467004.png?v=1" alt="necklaceofsalamancy" title="necklaceofsalamancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Provides a 10% accuracy and damage buff wild fighting dinosaurs.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Passive unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Artisans'_Workshop_Reward_Shop <strong><nowiki>Restocking Cannon Ability</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki>
    • Allows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> restocking without user input.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Anachronia_base_camp#Slayer_Lodge <strong><nowiki>Anachronia slayer lodge</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="venomous-dinosaurs"><ins><nowiki>Venomous Dinosaurs</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Venomous dinosaurs are the go-to for dinosaur tasks as they have the highest kills per hour of any dinosaur.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 1378 + 454.7 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="Constitution" title="Constitution" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 1332</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: 480</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour : ~640k</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Venomous Dinosaurs are located on the northwestern part of Anachronia, easily accessed by using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1354420110772928512.png?v=1" alt="nwanachronia" title="nwanachronia" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and heading east.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place the cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the yellow square and stand on the green square shown in the image below. This effectively aggros 5 dinosaurs. This works for all three methods.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If a dinosaur is getting stuck on the bone to the south while using Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, stand 1 tile east.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/WOzKMPVw24.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-and-afk-melee"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active and AFK Melee</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="malevolence" title="malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may be used to prevent excess damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Corbicula Rex </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117273821280.png?v=1" alt="corbicula" title="corbicula" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk from Ranch out of Time can increase KPH.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=51882ae9-509d-4e67-be76-59f676e6a71c <nowiki>Melee preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F51882ae9-509d-4e67-be76-59f676e6a71c.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="action-bar"><nowiki>Action Bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/bLMRGXzCII.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Thanks to the Venomous Dinosaurs' higher affinity to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (and susceptibility to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1" alt="inquisitorstaff" title="inquisitorstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) and damage reduction provided by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Cryptbloom Armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336168363561041.png?v=1" alt="cryptbloomtop" title="cryptbloomtop" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can achieve a similar or slightly higher KPH than melee at </nowiki><strong><nowiki>~480</nowiki></strong><nowiki> KPH, while being both very safe and AFK.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics_1"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=MopjYBuvJUpsaspbD93p <nowiki>Magic preset</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FMopjYBuvJUpsaspbD93p.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Prism of Restoration </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/938475261366784070.png?v=1" alt="prismofrestoration" title="prismofrestoration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be cast at least every 5min to keep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/839903693837959228.png?v=1" alt="reaverpouch" title="reaverpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> alive.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: This preset assumes the player has their </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in the Anachronia Stand.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="action-bar_1"><nowiki>Action Bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/1sj0CK2.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
 ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>Note: if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and/or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are not owned, simply ignore them and move the remaining abilities closer to the left. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is by no means a requirement, but can slightly improve KPH.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-afk-necromancy"><ins><nowiki>Method: AFK Necromancy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Thanks to Necromancies sustain with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809206423060632.png?v=1" alt="conjureghost" title="conjureghost" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434279311380532.png?v=1" alt="bloodsiphon" title="bloodsiphon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, as well as its strong aoe damage potential with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809145706319892.png?v=1" alt="spectralscythe" title="spectralscythe" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, it can effectively AFK Venomous Dinosaurs. Around 450-470kph can be achieved on task with this method while being safe and AFK with low input costs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1494069332584693810.png?v=1" alt="penanceaspect" title="penanceaspect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to help aggroing the dinosaurs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

Bars for all these dinosaurs might be sub-optimal, if you find a better bar please make a post in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there_1"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1" alt="brutishdinosaur" title="brutishdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are located east of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107319166107689.png?v=1" alt="venomousdinosaur" title="venomousdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, following the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>northern</nowiki></strong><nowiki> path at the fork in the road.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1" alt="feraldinosaur" title="feraldinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are in the same area, but found by following the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>south</nowiki></strong><nowiki> path.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1" alt="ripperdinosaur" title="ripperdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, teleport to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1" alt="laniakea" title="laniakea" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and walk north.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-melee-afk-feral-and-brutish"><nowiki>Method: Melee AFK - Feral and Brutish</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This method is viable for both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107322882261072.png?v=1" alt="feraldinosaur" title="feraldinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107321087103179.png?v=1" alt="brutishdinosaur" title="brutishdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but not </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1" alt="ripperdinosaur" title="ripperdinosaur" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936606347280.png?v=1" alt="turmoil" title="turmoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159416557573.png?v=1" alt="Malevolence" title="Malevolence" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Bring some emergency food or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1022562484378419284.png?v=1" alt="reaverscroll" title="reaverscroll" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for healing if having issues with HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201294262009874.png?v=1" alt="vampscrim" title="vampscrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for aggro.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-afk-magic-ripper"><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic - Ripper</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ripper dinosaurs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107317450641438.png?v=1" alt="ripperdinosaur" title="ripperdinosaur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are highly damaging and generally not worth doing unless getting a soul </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1" alt="ushabti" title="ushabti" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. They can only be reliably AFK'd with multiple pieces of Cryptbloom </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1334336169336373339.png?v=1" alt="cryptbloomhelm" title="cryptbloomhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and with Vampyrism aura </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505653079343144.png?v=1" alt="vampaura" title="vampaura" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The method below may not work if cutting corners such as not having </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="Affliction" title="Affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active before stocking the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /></p>
